description: This file contains unit tests for network address iterator classes, adapter classes, and related functionalities using the Google Test framework. The tests cover IPv4 and IPv6 address iteration, adapter status checks, and observer pattern implementation within the core networking module.

classes.name: AdapterIterator
classes.description: A class for iterating over network adapters, providing methods to check status and retrieve properties.

classes.name: IPV4AddressIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing IPv4 addresses associated with a network adapter.

classes.name: IPV6AddressIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing IPv6 addresses associated with a network adapter.

classes.name: NodeId
classes.description: Represents a network node address with methods to check attributes like multicast or local interface.

classes.name: AdapterObserver
classes.description: A class that implements observer pattern to be notified of adapter events.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next element.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the current iterator position is valid.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns the number of addresses or adapters.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the adapter.

methods.name: HostName
methods.description: Returns the hostname associated with a NodeId.

methods.name: HostAddress
methods.description: Returns the host address associated with a NodeId.

methods.name: Address
methods.description: Returns the current address object from the iterator.

methods.name: IsUp
methods.description: Checks if the adapter is operational.

methods.name: IsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the adapter is running.
